paragraphs: Rav Acha of Hutzal had a case concerning a vow involving his wife and came before Rav Ashi, Keritot 13b. Ravina reported his statement, Beitzah 32b. At the end of Ketubbot, “Babylonia will not see the birth pangs of the Messiah” is explained as Hutzal. Hutzal is near Nehardea, with Ezra the scribe’s sanctuary. There is also Hutzal of Benjamin, walled from Joshua’s days. (See Rav Ashi of Hutzal.)
